input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

This scene:
一个人问神农，哪个植物好吃。神农说，这就要看你的口味了。要是你喜欢吃甜的，有很多甜的水果，比方说苹果、西瓜和梨。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有好处。神农说，有很多种植物对你的身体有好处，比方说小白菜、黄瓜、茶和菠菜。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有坏处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一个别的人问神农：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 一个别的人问神农：第三个人

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Plants are grouped by type, so the measure word for asking which type of plant is needed here. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个别的人：另一个人，This phrase should identify the next distinct questioner. “别的” distinguishes other people or things from a stated one, while “另一个人” means one more person. [teacher rule: bieren]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use the measure word for a type of plant when asking which plant is beneficial. [rule: none]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个别的人：另一个人，This is another new questioner, so “另一个人” is the natural expression. [teacher rule: bieren]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use the measure word for a type of plant when asking which plant is harmful. [rule: none]

items.reason: “哪个植物” is acceptable Chinese here; “哪种植物” is only a possible rewording.
“一个别的人” is incorrect for another individual; “另一个人” correctly identifies a further questioner.
“哪个植物” is acceptable, so changing it to “哪种植物” is not a necessary correction.
“一个别的人” is wrong here, and “另一个人” is a grammatical way to introduce another questioner.
“哪个植物” is not erroneous; “哪种植物” is merely an alternative phrasing.
